summary: SAP SE filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on May 5, 2026. Shareholders voted on routine proposals including appropriation of retained earnings, approval of executive and supervisory board acts, appointment of auditors, compensation report, authorization to issue convertible bonds, election of supervisory board members, and amendment of articles to allow electronic shares. All items passed with affirmative votes. The filing is a routine disclosure of AGM voting results and does not involve any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or tender offer. No material corporate action triggering a special-situation classification is present.
